paint_finish.g1_5_details: Interpreted painted fasteners, access rings, generic service stencils, walkway wear and exhaust residue. Visual approximation, not measured historical rivet layout.
paint_finish.g1_6_details: Wider outlined fans, tapered interrupted stripe, scalloped nose apron, diamond, fin tip, light canopy frames, real identity requested by user. Clean racing finish.
paint_finish.g1_7_details: Service plates, EXPERIMENTAL, fin registration, resolved thin-edge filtering and blade oval badges. Underside service cover, underwing fasteners, localized lower-engine residue, satin inner door coating and perimeter paint details.
paint_finish.g1_7_underside_selection: Position-based ventral mask avoids inherited inward-facing fuselage corner normals; fuel-cap paint restricted to upper skin. Mesh normals unchanged.
paint_finish.gear_atlas: textures/gear/basecolor.png and orm.png; 2048 square, shared across all liveries
paint_finish.g1_8_details: Open wheel webs, tyre grooves, coated rims, metal hubs and bolts, thin interior-door reinforcement, shared satin well finish. Existing 101-frame rig retained.
paint_finish.g1_9_details: Interior door-specific 2048 PBR atlas with four editable coating/detail/wear layers, UV1; original exterior and wheel finish unchanged.
